notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section 5714–1 was editorially reclassified as section 11221 of Title 34, Crime Control and Law Enforcement.

notes.heading: Study of Housing Services and Strategies
notes.text: Pub. L. 108–96, title I, § 119, Oct. 10, 2003, 117 Stat. 1170, provided that the Secretary of Health and Human Services was to conduct a study of programs funded under part B of the Runaway and Homeless Youth Act (42 U.S.C. 5714–1 et seq.) to report on long-term housing outcomes for youth after exiting the program.
